verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 / DGX B200 is GPU hardware that the customer owns and runs on-premises. The user's data sits on their own storage rather than in a vendor-held account, so exporting your data and leaving is a category error for this product type. The evidence covers hardware specs, system management and the software stack, none of which bears on vendor-side data export. The closed-source Fabric Manager complaint concerns software openness, not data portability, so it does not make this axis apply.
